hints.title: Value Range Query Formulation
hints.text: For each number x, the predecessor must be in the range [max(1, x - k), x - 1] and strictly precede x in the array.

hints.title: Segment Tree Maximum Tracking
hints.text: Use a segment tree built over value domain [1, max_val] where each leaf stores the maximum length of a valid subsequence ending at that value.

hints.title: Point Update and Range Query
hints.text: For current value x, query the maximum in [max(1, x - k), x - 1], let it be L. Update position x in the segment tree with L + 1.

hints.title: Segment Tree Range Maximum Implementation

complexity.notes: Each element performs O(log(max_val)) range maximum query and point update on segment tree.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all earlier indices per element yields O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Segment tree maintains range maximums dynamically in 4 * max_val memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models dynamic programming transitions over bounded value ranges via segment tree.
